root.title: AcpTeachingAgent Explanation
root.content: Overview of the AcpTeachingAgent class and its functions.

children.title: Session Management
children.content: Handles creating, listing, loading, and closing sessions.

children.title: newSession
children.content: Creates a new session with tools and settings.

children.title: listSessions
children.content: Lists all active sessions and their details.

children.title: Prompt Handling
children.content: Processes user input and provides responses.

children.title: prompt
children.content: Runs the Koog agent on user input within a session.

children.title: cancel
children.content: Stops ongoing task in a session.

children.title: ReAct Pattern
children.content: Guide to think, act with tools, and observe results.

children.title: Reason
children.content: Think about the next steps before taking action.

children.title: Action
children.content: Use tools to perform tasks based on reasoning.

children.title: Observation
children.content: Evaluate tool results to determine the next steps.
